name: Track Switch Heating Power
description: Heating power required to keep a switch free of ice at minimum operating temperature. Checks whether installed capacity is sufficient.

elements.name: Required Switch Heating Power
elements.description: Power needed to maintain switch rail temperature above 0°C at design minimum ambient. Uncertain due to wind and precipitation.

uncertainty.source: Thermal simulation with wind and precipitation extremes

elements.name: Installed Heating Power
elements.description: Installed heating element power for this switch type

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(P_heat) = P_heat if P_heat <= P_installed, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The installed heater capacity guards the required heating power uncertainty set; required powers above 2400 W exceed the installed capacity.
